objective: Prove which steps of Braun's exponential Res(xor) bound for bit PHP carry over to the binary left-pigeon principle: separation of pigeon-row polynomials through the substitution g(h) := sum_x [f_x = h] x, and where the generic count and the affine removal step stop for the hole rows.
status: Proved 2026-11-10: pigeon-row separation transfers from bit PHP to bit LeftPigeon through g := sum_x [f_x = h] x (degree times l); Braun's generic criterion applies to LP_n with its own clauses, giving 3S + n(n+1)(l+1) >= exp(k^2/(3n) - 2) if the row-linear space over all rows is separated at degree k(12l+2); the pigeon rows alone are too thin. B100 reduces to row-linear separation over all rows.
title: What of Braun's bit-PHP argument transfers to bit LeftPigeon
